Pau Quesada's side host Paris FC this Tuesday (18:45 – Disney+) at the Alfredo Di Stéfano with a clear task: take all nine points from their three remaining matches if they want to challenge for a top-four finish and avoid the playoff round.

It is virtually all or nothing for Sandrine Soubeyrand's players in Valdebebas, and they are further hampered by the significant absence of their leading attacking threat, Clara Mateo, who is suspended after being sent off in the previous round.
